comments.author: @leechumbley5440
comments.text: Great to understand about the 2nd sea - sweet water bubbling up through salty water - thus Bahrain - '2 seas'   The rains of the last wet cycle 6,000 years ago form the Dammam aquifer and the W-E tilt of the Arabian Peninsula brings the underground water east under pressure. Such a good explanation of the erstwhile abundance of water, and the reason through overuse of its disappearance. What a fascinating history of trading between Sumeria and the Indus Valley and of the pearling industry. I worked in Saudi in the late 1970s and met some Bahrainis, who were much more sophisticated than the Saudis. The repressed Saudis used to come to liberal Bahrain for wine women and song forbidden in their Wahhabi homeland.
